snippet.title: Doom: Army of Darkness: Part 1 Evil Dead
snippet.description:
I had a lot of fun playing this Mod so decided to share it (Map by Stefan Maes, Music by Rick Sparks)
Secret 1 - 1:11
Secret 2 - 1:46
Bug: In early versions a Red Pillar blocks the Shed door, Making this Level impassable 
Next Part - https://www.youtube.com/watch?v=k-s0hyKJ08Y
